column1: # What this skill needs on the target machine at runtime, and how badly.
# The skill ships prebuilt rust binaries (chat/bin/chat-server-rs, the TLS IRC
# server; chat/bin/chat-client-rs, the TLS client). Neither is committed or
# built at install time: the release/CI builds them and the install.sh copies
# them. They have no runtime tool dependency — the server mints its self-signed
# certificate in-crate (rcgen) and the client pins it via TOFU.
